critical_findings.title: Dual project-config filenames split the single-config contract
critical_findings.fix: Load .cosmoflare.yaml first with .r2go2.yaml as legacy fallback; single cosmoflare: error prefix constant

critical_findings.title: runObjectPut god function with triple-duplicated upload paths (230 lines)
critical_findings.fix: Extract buildUploadOpts and reportUploadResult helpers; collapse stdin/resume/normal into one parameterized flow

critical_findings.title: 489 duplicated JSON-vs-human output branches across cmd/
critical_findings.fix: Add reportError/reportResult helpers that branch on JSONOutput once

critical_findings.title: internal/cli/operations (442 lines retry/batch logic) has zero tests; internal/migration at 10.4% coverage
critical_findings.fix: Table-driven tests for isRetryableError and retry loop with fault-injecting fake; migration happy path + failure

critical_findings.title: 234MB GOrchestra session artifacts tracked in git (81 recovery.patch files, some 665K lines); scanner flags AWS example keys inside transcripts
critical_findings.fix: gitignore GOrchestra/sessions/, git rm --cached, archive outside repo

critical_findings.title: golangci-lint panics (requires go1.27, built with go1.26) — no lint gate beyond go vet
critical_findings.fix: Rebuild golangci-lint with repo toolchain or pin compatible version; add to CI

critical_findings.title: CLI coverage 43.2% and library 65.3% while internals reach 93-100%
critical_findings.fix: Extend httptest-mock command test pattern to top-10 commands; target 60% for cmd

critical_findings.title: Raw cmd.Start() fire-and-forget violates ROAD-525 spawn policy (zombie processes)
critical_findings.fix: Use daemon.SpawnAsync or a goroutine cmd.Wait()

critical_findings.title: Non-constant-time token compare and no empty-token guard in server.New
critical_findings.fix: Reject empty Config.Token in New(); use crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare

critical_findings.title: MetricsSnapshot.Profile never populated; reflect.DeepEqual on untyped any fields
critical_findings.fix: Thread profile name from serve layer; type snapshot fields or compare via marshaled JSON

critical_findings.title: Dead code litter: 4 disabled packages, 4 .go.disabled cmd files, 6 empty internal dirs
critical_findings.fix: Delete empty dirs; archive disabled packages to a branch

recommendations.action: Unify project config to .cosmoflare.yaml with legacy .r2go2.yaml fallback and single error prefix
Extract shared output helpers to collapse 489 JSONOutput branches
Split runObjectPut, email.go, and installer_tui god files into subpackages
Add tests for internal/cli/operations and lift internal/migration from 10.4%
Untrack GOrchestra/sessions recovery patches (234MB) and gitignore the directory
Fix golangci-lint toolchain skew and add lint to CI
Harden server.New token validation with constant-time compare

roadmap_suggestions.title: Config unification (r2go2 to cosmoflare)
roadmap_suggestions.description: One project config filename, one error prefix, migration path for existing .r2go2.yaml users

roadmap_suggestions.title: CLI output helper refactor
roadmap_suggestions.description: Replace 489-site JSON/human dual-branch pattern with a shared reporting layer

roadmap_suggestions.title: Coverage floor for cmd/ and internal/cli
roadmap_suggestions.description: Bring cmd wiring to 60% using the proven httptest mock pattern; add CI coverage gate

roadmap_suggestions.title: Repo hygiene: purge GOrchestra session artifacts
roadmap_suggestions.description: 234MB of tracked recovery patches bloat clones and pollute security scans with false AWS-key hits

roadmap_suggestions.title: God-file decomposition
roadmap_suggestions.description: Break object.go (1183), email.go (1063), installer_tui/main.go (1299) into per-command subpackages under a 500-line budget
